description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged jump attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Wind with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Dragoon Mode I (Fang)] and [Dragoon Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Dual Awoken Dragoon Mode I (Fang)
description.text: Dragoon abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dragoon abilities trigger 2 additional times, changes air time to 0.01 seconds, 25%/50%/75%/100% additional critical chance for equipped Dragoon abilities after using 1/2/3/4+ Dragoon abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Dragoon Mode II (Fang)], removes [Dual Awoken Dragoon Mode I (Fang)]
